channel.desc: Comedy 2015 Despite a life lived in the spotlight and filled with indulgence, Danny Collins finds himself at a crossroads when he reads a letter sent to him four decades earlier. The words awaken a longing for truth, love, and a second chance at life. Al Pacino, Jennifer Garner, Annette Bening, Bobby Cannavale, Christopher Plummer, Dan Fogelman, Dan Fogelman.
